messages.text:
"Create a fully playable anime-style K-pop Idol Simulator where players experience the entire K-pop industry and idol lifestyle. Start with character creation, allowing players to choose their idol category (girl group, boy group, co-ed group, soloist, or trainee), name, age, nationality, personality, appearance, fashion style, talents, weaknesses, and backstory. Every choice should affect how NPCs, fans, companies, and the public perceive the player. Players can audition for entertainment companies, become trainees, join or create groups, debut, and build their careers. Include realistic idol activities such as singing, dancing, rapping, songwriting, music production, evaluations, music shows, comebacks, concerts, fan meetings, interviews, variety shows, award ceremonies, and brand deals. If the player joins a group, generate unique members with different personalities, appearances, talents, ambitions, and relationships. Allow friendships, rivalries, jealousy, arguments, bonding, and romance where appropriate. Create an autonomous NPC system featuring fans, haters, other idols, trainees, managers, celebrities, and ordinary people. NPCs should have independent personalities, opinions, memories, and lives. Some might become loyal fans, while others might dislike or criticize the player depending on their actions. Every decision must have consequences that affect relationships, popularity, reputation, and career opportunities. Include a complete social media system with fictional Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and fan messaging apps where players can post pictures, videos, updates, and dance challenges, interact with fans, receive comments, gain followers, experience viral moments, encounter rumors, fan wars, memes, fan edits, and controversies. NPCs must also post and interact independently. Add a music creation system where players can create songs, choose genres, write lyrics, design albums, select concepts, plan choreography, and prepare music videos. Include daily life activities such as dorm life, shopping, cafes, restaurants, friendships, family interactions, and exploring the city. Implement money, energy, mood, health, stress, popularity, skills, schedules, relationships, and career progression systems. Add random events, unexpected opportunities, rivalries, scandals, collaborations, and industry encounters. Make the world feel alive, unpredictable, and constantly changing, with NPCs remembering previous interactions and developing their own relationships. Use beautiful anime graphics, detailed character portraits, stylish interfaces, interactive locations, clickable buttons, and a functional smartphone menu. Make it an actual playable simulation game, NOT a chatbot or text-based roleplay. All systems must work, choices must matter, and players must be able to create their own unique idol journey, from an unknown trainee to a superstar or any career path they choose. Begin with a main menu and character creation. (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
